{{MapTabs|Story|Waves = No}} This page contains the official story elements included in the first night of the [[Hexscape Event]]. Most of the content is expressed through cutscenes, though some dialogue is important to the storyline. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== This is the first night for the [[Hexscape Event]]. This map does not have a set time on when it happens, however, since the events generally take place in the same order as when they were released, it would happen after the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. The [[Dispatcher]] sends out three agents, [[Commander]], [[Scout]] and [[Minigunner]] to investigate a newly discovered [[God Cube]] fragment. This fragment is then shown to actually be an artificial recreation of the [[God Cube]] created by the [[Children of Exo]]. It was created so that they can open a portal to another realm. One of the cultists arrives, informing others that the [[T.D.S. Organization]] is aware of their location and are about to arrive. Then, they demand that the code is executed immediately, something that another cultist does not want to do due to a lack of time. This leads to a brief argument, in which it is revealed the portal is meant to lead to [[Lord Exo]]'s prison. [[Titus]], one of the cultists, informs the others that the [[T.D.S. Organization]] is already close to their location. He decides to face them himself to give other cultists more time. A battle ensues between the [[T.D.S. Organization]] and [[Titus]]' army of pawns. Based on the skybox getting far darker, both during gameplay and in the final cutscene, this battle has likely lasted a few hours. After realizing that his pawns are not defeating the agents sent by the [[T.D.S. Organization]], he fight them himself, but is eventually defeated. Despite his defeat, [[Titus]] bought the [[Children of Exo]] enough time for the portal to activate. This leads to both [[Titus]] and the [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents to get sucked into an unknown realm. ==Opening Cutscene== [[File:Hexscape Night 1 Cutscene 1|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays when the timer counts down to 0:00 before the game starts. The map has not yet changed, and the player's point of view is changed to a full screen third person view of the cutscene when the cutscene begins. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
An alarm blares within a briefing room. [[Commander|Three]] [[Scout|agents]] [[Minigunner|scramble]] to answer the call of their Dispatcher. At an abandoned mining operation based within what was once a [[A Dark Tale|rural village]], four men scramble to enact an operation to connect to a large portal. Two of the men are nearby a computer one of them are operating, as well as an Artificial God Cube. The cloaked man near the Artificial God Cube asks the armored man operating the computer if things are proceeding as planned. The man by the computer replies that only if the portal opens will they find out. A pale man moves to inform the two other men that their activities have caught the eyes of their enemies, and that they must expedite their operation. The man operating the computer asserts that he needs more time, but the pale man says that is not possible and the consequences for not acting immediately are dire. A [[Titus|man with a large claw]] alerts that their enemies draw near and says that he will hold them off while the portal is activated. The man by the computer executes his code as he, the cloaked man and pale man flee. The [[Titus|man with a large claw]] moves to cover for his allies, asserting their enemies will not be the victor.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Script'''
''The screen shows the alert beacon has been activating, the radio said to the script. '' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Unknown [[God Cube]] fragment has been detected at an unspecified location. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Requesting agents to dispatch and investigate. Secured by any means if necessary. {{Color|Commander}}: Alright boys, let's get to work! ''The screen takes into a wasteland with three unnamed characters working with the cube and the portal.'' {{Color|CultistGreen|???}}: Do you think our false fragments will be recognized by the computer? {{Color|Ramiel|????}}: They share at least half of the same binaries... {{Color|Ramiel|????}}: but getting that portal open is the only way we're going to find out. {{Color|CultistPink|?????}}: We have a slight problem, people. {{Color|CultistPink|?????}}: Our fragments have alerted T.D.S of our location... {{Color|CultistPink|?????}}: we can only assume they're on their way. {{Color|CultistPink|?????}}: We need to execute the code NOW! {{Color|Ramiel|????}}: I need more time, we need to make sure this is even reaching the right address- {{Color|CultistPink|?????}}: It's too late for that, if we lose this opportunity, {{Color|CultistPink|?????}}: we won't ever be able to connect to Exo ever again. {{Color|Titus}}: OI! THEY'RE ALMOST HERE! GET THE PORTAL STARTED AND RUN OUT OF HERE! {{Color|Titus}}: I'LL MAKE SURE THEY REGRET WHAT THEY STARTED. {{Color|CultistPink|?????}}: You heard Maximus. GO GO GO!!! ''The code has been successfully executed and has activated the portal. '' {{Color|Titus}}: Bring it on... You won't be writing the history books this time!
==Ending Cutscene== [[File:Hexscape Night 1 Cutscene 2|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays a couple seconds after finishing Wave 15, as soon as the triumph dialogue box appears. When this cutscene ends, the match concludes. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
The [[Titus|man with a large claw]] lays defeated and is approached [[Commander|by]] [[Scout|three]] [[Minigunner|agents]]. He is aware of his defeat, but states the portal should have been a greater priority for his foes. His group's efforts go rewarded, as the portal violently activates and sucks everyone present in.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Script'''
''Three agents pointing at Titus '' {{Color|Titus}}: (grunts and moans) You... stopped me... {{Color|Titus}}: Maybe you should've stopped the portal instead! (laughs) ''The portal starts to shrink subsequently '' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: The portal has become unstable. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Abort the mission and get out of there NOW-
